instructions_en.title: How to Complete This Form
steps: This form tracks residential services and transportation provided each day of the month. Mark the days you provided services using the interactive grids below.
In the Residential Services Grid, mark each day you provided residential services:
Only complete this section if you are an approved Non-Medical Transport Provider with Real Care.
In the Transportation Services Grid, mark each day you provided transportation:
Once all information is complete and accurate:
Month: Enter the month you are reporting (e.g., January, February).
Provider's Name: Enter your full name as the service provider.
Person Receiving Services: Enter the full name of the client receiving services.
Click on any date (1-31) to mark it with an X indicating service was provided that day.
You can also use special codes: E (Enrollment), H (Hospital), R (Respite), V (Visit), I (Ineligible), T (Termination), VT (Vacant), J (Jail).
The grid automatically saves your selections as you work.
The total number of residential days will be calculated automatically.
